tei:div.tei:p: "$ (277)༄༅// blo sbyong brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dad pa'i gdung sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// thub pa'i dbang po rgyal tshab byams pa dang*// 'phags pa thogs med mkhas mchog dbyig gi gnyen// grol sde rnam gnyis gu ṇa mi tra dang*// seṅge bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs shing*// blos btang zlog sgom nus par byin gyis rlobs// gang spel ku sā li pa che chung dang*// gser gling pa dang mgon po a ti sha /'brom ston po to ba dang sha ra ba// rnal 'byor 'chang kha ba la= /byams dang = /blos btang = /spyil bu pa dang 'od zer bla ma dang*// lha sdings byang chub 'bum pa kun rgyam mtshan// yon tan dpal ba mkhan chen bde ba dpal// bka' bzhi grags pa gzhon nur gsol// byams dang= /blos btang = /byang sems bsod grags thogs med bzang po dpal// yon tan blo gros gzhon nu blo gros dang*// paṇa chen shākya mchog kun dga' mchog grub mtshan// rje btsun grol mchog zhabs la// byams dang = /blos btang = /lung rig rgya mtsho kun mkhyen sgrol ba'i mgon// rgyal tshab rnam gnyis rnal 'byor yon tan mgon// mgon po dpal 'byor mgon po grags pa'i mtshan// mgon po rnam par rgyal la= /byams dang = /blos btang = /tshe dbang nor bu phrin las shing rta'i zhabs// bstan pa'i nyin byed grub brnyes blo gros mtshan// karma lhag mthong gzhan phan 'od zer rje// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba= /byams dang = /glos btang = /zhen log nges 'byung gnyis pos gzhi bzung nas// theg chen las las phyir mi ldog pa'i gsang*// yang dag byang chub sems mchog rnam (278)pa gnyis// skyes brtan gong du 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// chos brgyad rmangs bsgyel bdag 'dzin rtsad nas bcad// gzhan gces gting nas 'byongs te ci snang kun// byang chub lam gyi grogs su khyer nus pa'i// blo sbyong mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs// don dam skye 'gag gnas bral stong nyid dang*// kun rdzob rten 'brel sgyu ma'i tshul rtogs nas// srid pa ji srid mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don// lhun grub thams cad gzigs par bdag gyur cig
/ces pa 'di'ang blo sbyong khrid yig gi yan lag tu blo gros mtha' yas kyis spel ba shu bhaṃ/// /
